# References {.unnumbered}

## Source workflow and data

**Magnitov M, et al.** (2024) *Molecular Cell*.
[doi 10.1016/j.molcel.2024.11.031](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.molcel.2024.11.031).
The study whose TT-seq workflow TTpipe reimplements. Data: GEO
[GSE260914](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE260914). The
authors' code is at <https://github.com/magnitov/zfp143>; the scale factors the
pipeline guide quotes come from there. TTpipe follows a pipeline guide for this
paper; it is not the authors' code.

**dietJuicer** (PhanstielLab). The pipeline layout, samplesheet and profile
conventions TTpipe follows. <https://github.com/PhanstielLab/dietJuicer>

## The method

**Schwalb B, et al.** TT-seq maps the human transient transcriptome. *Science*
**352**:1225-1228 (2016). TT-seq.

**Gregersen LH, Mitter R, Svejstrup JQ.** Using TTchem-seq for profiling nascent
transcription and measuring transcript elongation. *Nature Protocols* **15**:604-627
(2020). TTchem-seq.

**Nabet B, et al.** The dTAG system for immediate and target-specific protein
degradation. *Nature Chemical Biology* **14**:431-441 (2018). The degron tag used
in the example data.

## Software

**Snakemake.** Mölder F, et al. Sustainable data analysis with Snakemake.
*F1000Research* **10**:33 (2021). <https://snakemake.github.io>

**FastQC.** Andrews S. <https://www.bioinformatics.babraham.ac.uk/projects/fastqc/>

**fastp.** Chen S, Zhou Y, Chen Y, Gu J. fastp: an ultra-fast all-in-one FASTQ
preprocessor. *Bioinformatics* **34**:i884-i890 (2018).

**STAR.** Dobin A, et al. STAR: ultrafast universal RNA-seq aligner.
*Bioinformatics* **29**:15-21 (2013). <https://github.com/alexdobin/STAR>

**samtools.** Danecek P, et al. Twelve years of SAMtools and BCFtools.
*GigaScience* **10**:giab008 (2021). <https://github.com/samtools/samtools>

**Picard.** Broad Institute. <https://broadinstitute.github.io/picard/>

**deepTools.** Ramírez F, et al. deepTools2: a next generation web server for
deep-sequencing data analysis. *Nucleic Acids Research* **44**:W160-W165 (2016).

**HTSeq.** Anders S, Pyl PT, Huber W. HTSeq: a Python framework to work with
high-throughput sequencing data. *Bioinformatics* **31**:166-169 (2015).
<https://htseq.readthedocs.io>

**DESeq2.** Love MI, Huber W, Anders S. Moderated estimation of fold change and
dispersion for RNA-seq data with DESeq2. *Genome Biology* **15**:550 (2014).

**GSEA.** Subramanian A, et al. Gene set enrichment analysis: a knowledge-based
approach for interpreting genome-wide expression profiles. *PNAS* **102**:15545-15550
(2005).

**fgsea.** Korotkevich G, et al. Fast gene set enrichment analysis. bioRxiv (2016).
<https://github.com/ctlab/fgsea>

**MultiQC.** Ewels P, et al. MultiQC: summarize analysis results for multiple tools
and samples in a single report. *Bioinformatics* **32**:3047-3048 (2016).

**GENCODE.** Frankish A, et al. GENCODE 2021. *Nucleic Acids Research* **49**:D916-D923
(2021). Release M25 (mouse) is the default annotation:
<https://www.gencodegenes.org/mouse/>

**MSigDB** (gene sets for GSEA). <https://www.gsea-msigdb.org/gsea/msigdb>
